description: fnd hook wiring for Codex — the canonical Claude Code hooks in Codex hooks.json envelope form (M1b measured live 2026-08-23: the top level is {description, hooks}, not a bare event map). Guards block by exit code; PostToolUse routes through codex-mcp-shim because Codex cannot rewrite tool output.

hooks.command: r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; echo "fnd plugin root: $r"; for f in comment-discipline plugin-feedback task-workspace mcp-whale; do cat "$r/hooks/$f.md" 2>/dev/null; done; if [ -f shopify.theme.toml ] || [ -f .env ]; then cat "$r/hooks/store-access.md" 2>/dev/null; fi; [ "${FND_LEAN:-1}" = "0" ] || cat "$r/hooks/lean-code.md" 2>/dev/null; true
